compiled_state.title: Revert scratch/sc10-scenario.py from PR (ephemeral cleanup)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
(None — cleanup task; DD ownership is implicit via task-1/task-2/task-3/task-4 having already captured the SC10 evidence. The scenario file is ephemeral per the selected approach's 'Considerations — Cleanup' clause.)

Add a follow-up commit on task-1's PR branch that removes `scratch/sc10-scenario.py` (either `git rm` + commit, or `git revert <scenario-commit-sha>`). This MUST happen after task-4 has captured the SC10 Evidence pointers — the evidence references commit SHAs that remain in PR history because reverting/removing in a new commit does not rewrite history. Subsequent merge or close of the PR is out of scope for this task.

Note on test exemption: test-exempt — file removal; the removed file had no associated tests (it was a synthetic input fixture, never unit-tested).

## Acceptance Criteria

**Universal (always run):**
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Tests pass
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && bash tests/run-all.sh

**Task-specific:**
- [ ] Revert commit pushed removing scratch/sc10-scenario.py from PR branch
  Verify: PR_NUM=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket show 8304-b0e1-c112-4f07 | grep -oE 'PR: #[0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+'); BRANCH=$(gh pr view $PR_NUM --json headRefName --jq .headRefName); ! git ls-tree -r origin/$BRANCH --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^scratch/sc10-scenario.py$'
- [ ] Revert commit message references `Revert "scratch/sc10-scenario.py"` or equivalent
  Verify: PR_NUM=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket show 8304-b0e1-c112-4f07 | grep -oE 'PR: #[0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+'); gh pr view $PR_NUM --json commits --jq '.commits[-1].messageHeadline' | grep -qiE 'revert|remove.*scenario'
